definitions.explanation: The act of giving in to pressure, force, or authority, accepting defeat or submitting to someone's will.

examples.japanese: ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈服|くっぷく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They gave in to the pressure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脅|おど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈服|くっぷく}⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He did not yield to the threats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈服|くっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いた→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧。
examples.english: Without yielding to violence, he stuck to his beliefs until the end.

notes:
A compound of {屈|くつ} (to bend, to yield) and ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (to submit, to obey). Conveys a sense of being forced to submit against one's will.

USAGE:
Typically used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate what one submits to: ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈服|くっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (submit to pressure). Often used in negative constructions to express defiance or resistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屈服|くっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to submit, to yield
- {屈服|くっぷく}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ — to force into submission
- ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈服|くっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to yield to pressure
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈服|くっぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to submit to authority

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{降伏|こうふく}→降伏：03770_koufuku⟧ — surrender; specifically military capitulation
- ⟦{服従|ふくじゅう}→服従：15351_fukujuu⟧ — obedience; ongoing compliance with authority
- ⟦{譲歩|じょうほ}→譲歩：09143_jouho⟧ — concession; a more neutral, voluntary compromise
